title: Gravitational Duals from Equations of State II: Large Hierarchies and False Vacua
abstract: arXiv:2606.30117v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We investigate the reconstruction of holographic duals for strongly coupled quantum field theories in regimes characterized by large hierarchies and the presence of false vacua. Within the gauge/gravity duality, these features translate into non-trivial thermodynamic behaviour and exotic renormalization group flows, including skipping flows between non-adjacent fixed points. Building on previous work based on Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs), we extend the holographic inverse problem of reconstructing the bulk scalar potential from boundary thermodynamic data into this new regime. This setting presents a variety of conceptual and numerical challenges, such as near-degenerate states, large hierarchies of energy scales, and regions of the potential that are not directly probed by the input data. translated_title: 从状态方程到引力对偶 II：大能级层级与伪真空
translated_abstract: 我们研究了在以大层级和伪真空存在为特征的区域内，强耦合量子场论的全息对偶重构问题。在规范/引力对偶框架下，这些特征转化为非平凡的热力学行为和新奇的重整化群流，包括在非相邻不动点之间发生的“跳跃流”。在以往基于物理信息神经网络（PINNs）工作的基础上，我们将“从边界热力学数据重构体标量势”这一全息逆问题扩展到了这一新的区域。这一设定带来了诸多概念和数值上的挑战，例如近简并态、能量尺度的大层级，以及势能中未被输入数据直接探测到的区域。我们开发了一系列方法学上的改进来克服这些障碍，从而改进了已有的基于PINNs的方法。
tldr: 该论文将基于物理信息神经网络（PINNs）的全息逆问题方法扩展至具有大能级层级和伪真空的强耦合量子场论情形，通过一系列方法学改进克服了近简并态与势能未探测区域等挑战，实现了从边界热力学数据重构体标量势。
en_tdlr: This paper extends the PINNs-based holographic inverse problem to strongly coupled quantum field theories with large hierarchies and false vacua, developing methodological advances to reconstruct the bulk scalar potential from boundary thermodynamic data despite near-degenerate states and unprobed potential regions.
